description: This PHP source file defines the API class 'ClaimEventAPI' for managing claim events within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting claim events, along with validation rules, annotations for API documentation (Swagger/OpenAPI), and usage of traits and dependencies for database access and authentication.

classes.name: ClaimEventAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for managing ClaimEvent entities, supporting CRUD operations, validation, and documentation. Implements the CrudEndpoint interface and includes traits for database and authentication support.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new ClaimEvent entity with provided name, description, and status; returns the created model.

methods.name: setClaimEvent
methods.description: Populates a ClaimEvent entity with data from request parameters and saves it via DAO.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ClaimEvent entities based on search filters, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for listing ClaimEvents with filters and pagination.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for creating a new ClaimEvent, including uniqueness validation.

methods.name: getNameRule
methods.description: Constructs validation rule for the 'name' property, including length and uniqueness.

methods.name: getClaimEventCommonUniqueOption
methods.description: Provides common options for unique property validation, ignoring deleted records.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes claim events specified by IDs; returns the list of deleted IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for delete operation.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves details of a single ClaimEvent by ID, including whether it can be edited.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for retrieving a single ClaimEvent by ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing ClaimEvent; restricts name modification if the event is already used.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating a ClaimEvent, including conditional name validation.
